items.html: However, the deficiency that was now in the exile of Babylon is that those illuminations that the seven upper [Sefirot] illuminated — in which Bina expanded in ZA, as above, in the days of the First Temple, and all of them illuminated in her in the aspect of face to face, as above — these lights all descended and were drawn into the Klipot, alas. But not her own first ten Sefirot, as above, which ascended in ZA; rather, these seven lights descended into the Klipot, and she returned back to back, on weekdays.
